description: Rule-based deadline calculator widget. Computes a deadline from a base date and a chained rule (calendar days, business days, weeks, months, years — each with configurable weekend/holiday shifting) through the pure DeadlineCalculator engine, showing a live result and a step-by-step protocol. Holiday calendars are pluggable via IHolidayProvider; ShowForm="false" gives an embed mode that renders only the result and protocol.

parameters.name: BaseDate
parameters.description: Base date the periods count from. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: BaseDateChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the base date changes in the form.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description: Initial deadline rule. The component edits its own copy; use RuleChanged to observe edits.

parameters.name: RuleChanged
parameters.description: Raised with a snapshot of the edited rule after every form change.

parameters.name: HolidayProvider
parameters.description: Holiday calendar source. The component loads exactly the year span the calculation can touch.

parameters.name: Weekend
parameters.description: Weekend days. Default is Saturday and Sunday.

parameters.name: ShowForm
parameters.description: Whether the rule form is rendered. False gives the embed mode (result + protocol only).

parameters.name: ShowProtocol
parameters.description: Whether the step-by-step protocol is rendered.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.
